messages:
kevin: Quick flag: onboarding quickstart's canary rollout isn't receiving traffic when using the JS SDK. REST POST works fine.

ana: can you paste the snippet?

kevin: minimal repro (node sdk v2.5.1):
```js
await admin.createRoute({
  serviceId: 'sample-traffic',
  name: 'chat',
  model: 'redwood-stable',
  trafficSplit: [ { model: 'redwood-canary', weight: 20 } ], // expect 20% to canary
});
```
After creation, GET /admin/routes/:id -> traffic: { redwood-stable: 100 } (canary absent).

sam: I repro'd locally. SDK serializes `trafficSplit` -> JSON array named `traffic_split`, server RPC expects a `traffic` object mapping model -> percentage. REST gateway accepts both shapes and normalizes; SDK is sending a shape the RPC ignores. So the canary ends up unwired.

kevin: ugh. that's a nasty silent drift for new users following quickstart examples. They assume partial rollout but actually get 100% stable.

ana: aside: noticed some users also getting higher latency because SDK isn't sending the `X-Region-Hint` header the REST quickstart sets. That causes routing to default region and adds cross-region latency in onboarding runs. Two different DX gaps: payload shape and missing region hint header.

sam: agreed. Proposal: SDK should accept both ergonomic shapes (array-of-objects) and the canonical `traffic` map and always serialize to `traffic` map in outgoing payload. Also add an option to set `regionHint` on client and emit `X-Region-Hint` header for admin calls. Backcompat: log a one-line deprecation when old shape used.

eng-runtime: server-side can add a compatibility shim but we prefer SDK normalization for clearer contract. Filed ENG-7421 to track server-side shim as fallback.

ci-bot: CI queued: branch fix/sdk-traffic-serialization (#4182)  unit+integration tests.

kevin: another subtlety: when admin createRoute returns 409 due to concurrent rollout updates, the SDK retry wrapper retries the same mutating call without an idempotency key and the second attempt creates a second ephemeral rollout object; server dedupe doesn't trigger. REST quickstarts include an idempotency header and retry safely. Can we auto-generate `Idempotency-Key` for mutating admin ops or preserve user-supplied ones and retry only when present?

sam: yes. We'll add auto-gen idempotency by default for quickstart client instances, and a client config option to opt-out. Also ensure retry wrapper preserves headers (some internal wrapper was dropping custom headers on retry).

ana: short-term mitigation: update quickstart README to recommend using REST POST with explicit traffic map and to set `X-Region-Hint`. Example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/routes 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "X-Region-Hint: us-west-2" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"serviceId":"sample-traffic","name":"chat","traffic":{"redwood-stable":80,"redwood-canary":20}}'
```

eng-runtime: created ENG-7421, DX ticket DX-9010 "js-sdk: normalize traffic shapes + region hint header + idempotency on admin mutates" with repro and rollout plan.

kevin: working on small SDK PR to accept array shape and map to `traffic` plus add `regionHint` client option. Will include tests for retries preserving headers.

ci-bot: merge completed for fix/sdk-traffic-serialization -> main; release candidate 2.5.2-rc published.

sam: I'll follow up to validate server-side shim and confirm no long-tail effects in rollout telemetry.

kevin: thanks all. I'll update the quickstart README and ping support so they know to look for `traffic` vs `trafficSplit` and missing `X-Region-Hint` if users report canary missing. :thumbsup:
